name: Kokutou Misuzu
source:
Takuma's kouhai. For some time she has tried to be his girlfriend. Despite claiming to be a serious and inflexible person she has a very compassionate heart. Would do anything for Takuma.

She's the reincarnation of Cleopatra VII Philopator (Cleopatra).
